dedupe_keys.name: origine des saisines du mediateur sncf

description: Origine des saisines du Médiateur SNCF is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ces données sont issues des rapports annuels du Médiateur SNCF. La Médiation SNCF permet aux voyageurs de demander un deuxième avis sur leurs réclamations. Elle constitue un mode de règlement simple et gratuit des litiges entre SNCF et ses clients. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Informations Institutionnelles. Its keywords are Médiateur, Litiges. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
